purpose: Retain portable observations and tensions independently of a chosen chapter. A reported preference does not establish a tested gem or adoption.

ideas.title: Less time inside the same distance
ideas.idea: A fixed spatial path becomes a different encounter when its pace changes.
ideas.anchor: The rods have not grown, but there is less time inside the same distance.
ideas.evidence: Supplied packet reading identifies this sentence as worth preserving. Code shares X positions at four rates; no headset sensation is inferred.
ideas.risk: Conflating speed with another source of randomness or prescribing a feeling.
ideas.next_test: Compare which draft makes the pace change matter without explaining an emotion.

ideas.title: Marks become available after withdrawal
ideas.idea: Movement leaves a surface that can be examined when following has ended.
ideas.evidence: The supplied reading asks for more attention to the recording wall. Current ink persists after release; return motion adds no marks.
ideas.risk: Treating the image as a complete recording of the bodily event.
ideas.next_test: Does the reader want to compare marks, revisit a motion, or inspect a dark patch?

ideas.title: A dense image does not identify its source
ideas.idea: Selected destinations and interpolated travel both contribute to the visible marks.
ideas.evidence: Installed targets are uniform; twelve phase samples per segment contribute ink. Gaussian generation exists in reconstruction code without a room selector.
ideas.risk: Inferring a Gaussian source from a crowded centre, or offering a control absent from the exhibit.
ideas.next_test: Retain endpoints and path samples separately in a future reconstruction; compare their distributions.

ideas.title: Production, recording and selection
ideas.idea: A hand can change which result stays available without having produced that result.
ideas.evidence: Earlier user response distinguishes producing, recording and selecting. Touch toggles a generated five-digit group; release of the hand alone does not release it.
ideas.risk: Flattening all kinds of keeping into one metaphor, or implying a complete table proves provenance.
ideas.next_test: Can a reader distinguish what the touch changes here from what it changes at the abacus?

ideas.title: A date interrupts a repeating present
ideas.idea: A retained acquisition document and a replaying calculation have different temporalities.
ideas.evidence: Supplied reading values the receipt beside the repeating gaps. The receipt reports 435 acquired on 13 October; the current sequence is synthesized and reused.
ideas.risk: Making the receipt prove more than it records, or treating later clicks as new physical measurements.
ideas.next_test: Does documentary interruption create curiosity without requiring a second explanatory summary?

ideas.title: A clock loses a distinction while the sound keeps it
ideas.idea: The same retained event times can yield different measured comparisons.
ideas.evidence: Changing comparison resolution preserves events/audio; equal measured intervals are skipped.
ideas.risk: Confusing quantization with changed event timing or asserting every coarser comparison loses the same amount.
ideas.next_test: Keep the same trace, change resolution, and ask what disappeared from which representation.

ideas.title: A movement becomes one of a thousand beginnings
ideas.idea: Bodily input can alter a generator while many distinctions in its measurement do not survive the seed mapping.
ideas.evidence: Pose records are rounded, hashed and reduced modulo 1000. Different records can collide; no found pair is claimed. The saved room currently removes this part.
ideas.risk: Describing an absent stop as installed, certifying true randomness, or claiming an unperformed collision trial.
ideas.next_test: Resolve placement; retain two different records with the same seed and compare consequences.

ideas.title: Another draw cannot repeal the return
ideas.idea: Variation within an excursion and alteration of its route rule are different capacities.
ideas.evidence: User's full reading found the distinction consequential. Direction/distance vary while the sphere's return remains authored; release ends body carry.
ideas.risk: Equating the sphere's compulsory return with a player being forced to remain attached.
ideas.next_test: Does the ending prompt another seed choice or a proposal to alter the rule—and why?

ideas.title: A visible cell can cease to support a body
ideas.idea: A computational distinction can arrive as a spatial event before it receives an explanation.
ideas.anchor: The faint tile can still be seen after it can no longer carry you.
ideas.evidence: Supplied packet reading prefers this CA encounter. It belongs to CA_ExpandingSpace, not Random Definition; proximity affects health and support thresholds.
ideas.risk: Importing a bridge into the wrong room, prescribing a moral, or describing pressure sensing.
ideas.next_test: Look for a comparably precise consequence in randomness without copying the bridge's plot.

ideas.title: Replay supplies events, not the first encounter
ideas.idea: The procedure can repeat while recognition, attention and reading duration change.
ideas.evidence: Repeatable paths and event lists are implemented. What a listener or visitor learns from repetition remains open.
ideas.risk: Claiming an inevitable response to repetition or treating reading speed as simulated time.
ideas.next_test: Ask what changed on the second reading or hearing; retain a report of no gain.

ideas.title: A new record would keep the release point
ideas.idea: An encounter can reveal something the apparatus does not currently preserve.
ideas.evidence: Candidate A imagines wanting a mark where carry ends. No such mark is asserted to exist.
ideas.risk: Making a narrator's proposal look like a participant request or a shipped feature.
ideas.next_test: Does another reader want this record; what would it let them compare?

decision_log.action: Retained supplied ideas and technical tensions for five exploratory full-chapter candidates.
decision_log.note: Palle requested divergent texts. The supplied reader's provisional calibration preference remains distinct from Palle's approval.
